items.name: button

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status label for categories, counts, and metadata: gray/brand/success/warning/error colors, subtle/outline/solid fills, sm/md/lg sizes, label or icon-only type, leading icon/avatar/dot and trailing icon slots, and a dismiss action.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input field for forms and data entry, with leading/trailing icon slots and an error state.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form field wrapper combining label, helper text, and error message. Compose with Input, Textarea, Select, and other form controls.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text input for longer form content, with an error state and resizable height.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Selectable checkbox for boolean or indeterminate values, built on Radix UI.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Group of mutually exclusive radio options, built on Radix UI.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Toggle switch for on/off binary settings, built on Radix UI.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Contextual feedback message for user actions or system events, with optional dismiss and action.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading indicator for async operations, in sm, md, and lg sizes.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: Visual separator between content sections, horizontal or vertical with an optional label.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder loading shape for content that has not yet loaded, as a text line, circle, or rectangle.

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: Progress Bar
items.description: Determinate progress indicator for file uploads, form steps, and task completion, in sm, md, and lg sizes.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Navigation breadcrumb trail showing page hierarchy, composed of breadcrumb items with chevron or slash separators, an ellipsis for collapsed crumbs, and a dropdown current crumb.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Informational popup that appears on hover or focus, built on Radix UI.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Contextual menu with selectable items and keyboard navigation, built on Radix UI.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: Dialog overlay for confirmations, forms, and focused tasks, built on Radix UI.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tab navigation for switching between content panels, in underline and pill variants, built on Radix UI.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Dropdown selection input with sm/md/lg/xl/2xl sizes and an error state, built on Radix UI.

items.name: select-v2
items.title: Select V2 (Restrained)
items.description: Restrained Select variant: same sizes, tokens, and states as Select plus a hover state (bg-secondary + border-strong). Built on the same Radix UI primitive.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Non-modal notification for brief action feedback, with info/success/warning/error variants and an imperative useToast() hook.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation control with sm/md/lg sizes, page links, and prev/next buttons.

items.name: pagination-v2
items.title: Pagination V2 (Restrained)
items.description: Additive Pagination variant built from Figma's real 'v2, restrained' frame, confirmed token-for-token identical to Pagination (same radius/md chrome, same per-size gap scale), with the same hover affordance v1 already uses since the extra hover state Figma publishes for v2 renders pixel-identical to default. Same sm/md/lg sizes as Pagination; does not replace it.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating content panel anchored to a trigger, built on Radix UI.

items.name: popover-v2
items.title: Popover V2 (Restrained)
items.description: Additive Popover variant built from Figma's real 'v2, restrained' frame, same default chrome as Popover, plus a real hover state and a dimmed disabled state v1 doesn't have. Same Radix UI primitive as Popover; does not replace it.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Vertically stacked interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

items.name: accordion-v2
items.title: Accordion V2 (Restrained)
items.description: Additive, visually-quieter Accordion variant: a borderless list with a single divider between items instead of per-item boxes, tighter padding, and a real hover state v1 doesn't have. Same Radix UI primitive as Accordion; does not replace it.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Flexible content container with optional image, title, and description.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A range input control for selecting a numeric value within a defined range.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A set of two or more toggle buttons that allows users to choose one option from a group.

items.name: progress-circle
items.title: Progress Circle
items.description: Circular progress indicator showing completion percentage.

items.name: verification-code-input
items.title: Verification Code Input
items.description: Segmented input for entering verification or OTP codes.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A focused confirmation overlay that requires user action before proceeding.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A data table for structured content, in default, striped, and bordered variants.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: A text input that converts entries into removable tags/chips.

items.name: tag-input-v2
items.title: Tag Input V2 (Restrained)
items.description: Additive Tag Input variant: no confirmable Figma 'v2, restrained' frame exists for Tag Input, so this was built structurally from Popover's real v2 frame (an added hover state and an added disabled/dimmed state, chrome otherwise identical to v1). Adds a hover border treatment TagInput never had, and dims the whole control when disabled instead of only tinting its background. Same sm/md/lg sizes as Tag Input; does not replace it.
